notes: Do not run install commands without explicit user confirmation.
If a connector is installed through Codex UI rather than a system package, direct the user to the relevant plugin or connector flow.
Missing optional role-based tools are informational on machines where the current user does not need that role. Do not pressure-install them just because the detector reports them missing.
For team rollout, recommend optional role-based tools only to teammates whose selected role or director focus needs them.
Atlassian CLI (`acli`) complements the Rovo connector and should be available on PATH for Jira fallback operations.
Azure Boards is accessed through Azure DevOps tooling, normally the Azure CLI with the Azure DevOps extension plus any available Codex connector/MCP.
AWS connector/MCP availability depends on the user's Codex/plugin install set; the local detector can only verify the AWS CLI.
